scope: Existing finite-contract controller traces and synthetic solver microbenchmark. No new runtime execution or provider calls.

units.request_bytes: Measured serialized model-adapter call JSON in UTF-8 bytes; not tokens or paid API cost.
units.context_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the selected context representation text, including separators.
units.declared_work_units: Declared preparation work plus fixed execution estimate; not elapsed time, tokens or money.

initial_basis.reason: Planner input identity includes selection_policy; equality is checked on all five initial input artifacts, candidate costs and declared budgets separately.

arms.public_label: 执行成本排序（忽略 P）

fixture_reward.interpretation: Fixture bookkeeping only; never plot as model efficacy.
Fixture bookkeeping only; never plot as model efficacy.

offline_trace.interpretation: The policies choose different first actions under identical declared initial inputs and candidate estimates. Seven verified fixture phases exercise version change, dependency repair and resource release. This is a control-path test, not model benefit evidence.

planner_scaling.reference: same Pareto solver with obligation graph forced into one component
planner_scaling.labels_explored_unit: DP 转移次数（seed/generated useful DP transitions），不是去重后的 distinct states。保留原始字段名 labels_explored 便于核验。

status_definitions.exact: allowed=true, reason=ready: solver returned a cover within the declared finite instance and identical label cap.
status_definitions.capped: reason=complexity_limit: stopped at 20000 labels; no solved reference, no selected cover or cost, no speedup ratio.

planner_scaling.cost_units: Synthetic declared representation/preparation units (small=1, large=2), including context separator accounting; not bytes, model tokens, API fees or agent reward.
planner_scaling.wall_time_units: Relative observed median wall time only, factorized=1 within each case, and only when both solve; machine-specific microbenchmark, not a general speedup claim.

separate_parallel_control.resource_snapshot: read-only mac vm_stat free/inactive/speculative proxy; offline fixture only

acceptance.scope: Finite-contract dynamic coding pilot. No claimed real-model efficacy, no replacement for original 46-case evaluation.

supported: Same declared input basis, two policy choices, real recorded offline controller order.
v1 to v2 mutation, dependency-specific redo, independent fixture verification, and lease/resource release.
Exact finite solver results and label-cap behavior on 11 recorded synthetic cases; same solved covers/costs where comparable.
Recorded source/package regression and offline acceptance counts within their stated scope.
unsupported: Real-model reward, token savings, paid API cost reduction or efficacy.
General wall-time speedup, asymptotic performance guarantee, or solved-reference ratios for capped cases.
Live production Linux resource admission, real Docker verification, or replacement of the original 46-case evaluation.
Model token or monetary interpretation of request bytes or declared work units.
